mapper.select: SELECT bank_account_id AS account_id, account_pin_hash AS pin_hash, balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bank_account_id = #{accountId} AND registered_person_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT ba.bank_account_id AS account_id, rp.name, ba.bank_code, ba.bank_name, ba.account_number FROM bank_accounts ba JOIN registered_persons rp ON rp.registered_person_id = ba.registered_person_id AND rp.user_id = ba.user_id WHERE ba.user_id = #{userId} AND ba.bank_account_id = #{accountId} AND ba.registered_person_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions ( user_id, bank_account_id, counterparty_bank_account_id, pattern_execution_id, transaction_type, transaction_category, amount, counterparty_name, counterparty_bank_code, counterparty_bank_name, counterparty_account_number, description, balance_after, transaction_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{recipientAccountId}, #{patternExecutionId}, 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'TRANSFER', #{amount}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientBankCode}, #{recipientBankName}, #{recipientAccountNumber}, #{description}, #{balanceAfter}, #{transactionAt} )
